name: Wild heart
description: A young boy abducted from a wealthy family grows up on the streets, forming a tight bond with other street children as he survives hardship and violence. Years later, he is unexpectedly reunited with his biological family, forcing him to navigate two completely different worlds. Torn between his past identity and new family ties, he fights to reclaim his place while confronting betrayal, class conflict, and emotional wounds.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Yaman, who has struggled to survive on the streets for as long as he can remember, has established a family for himself with Cesur, Asi and Umut, whom he crossed paths with when he was a child. Unaware of why and how they ended up on the streets , these four young people chose to leave their childhood traumas behind and hold on to each other. They are happy despite the difficult life conditions they live in. Their only concern is Umut's treatment. They pinned their hopes on a foreign doctor advertised as the "Miracle Doctor" so that Umut could walk . At the end of a routine day of collecting paper, Yaman meets Rüya and Alaz and finds himself in a strange journey. He is unaware that this little adventure he embarked on to help these two spoiled young people will take him back to his lost childhood...

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Yaman is distraught when he escapes from the Soysalans' mansion. He is devastated by the possibility that Alaz, whom he beat up, could be his brother and, most painful of all, that the woman he accidentally stabbed could be his mother. Maybe he has found his family, but he no longer has the face to knock on the door of that house he sneaked into through his window. The police and the Soysalans are looking for him everywhere. However, Yaman is determined to learn the truth before surrendering to the police. Even though he has no evidence other than the half-torn childhood photo he has been carrying with him for as long as he can remember... When he confronts Neslihan with the help of Rüya, things do not go as he imagined... Now, even if the truth is revealed, very deep wounds have been opened that will not be closed...

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Despite everything, Neslihan had a DNA test done with Yaman's hair, and Yaman turned out to be Ali,  her missing son who had been kidnapped years ago. As Yaman is abducted from the press and taken to his home, both those who stayed behind and those who were waiting for him are in shock. Neslihan, Eşref, and Serhan struggle to make amends for what they did to Yaman, while Alaz and Çağla have no intention of accepting him as their brother. Cesurlar, on the other hand, causes problems because he believes they have been abandoned. Just when Yaman believes that he will be able to reassert himself as "Yaman Ali" and that everything will be okay, Alaz and Çağla plan an ugly birthday surprise that breaks the strings. As Yaman leaves that house, never to return, the bitter truth he will learn will change all the rules of the game.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Yaman remembered that he was kept in the cellar of Rüya's house during the days when he was kidnapped. Rüya's uncle, İlker, kidnapped him. Moreover, at the request of someone from the Soysalan family... It will not be easy for Yaman to digest this truth. Realizing that he is the victim of a dirty game that extends from the family of the girl he is about to fall in love with to his own family, Yaman has opened the door of the past full of secrets and there is no turning back. While Cesur, unaware of what Yaman is up to, gets into big trouble with the ambition of proving that they can survive without Yaman, the opportunity Alaz was looking for falls in front of him. Alaz is now pulling Cesur's strings... And, therefore, Yaman's... Yaman, on the other hand, is about to find the answer to the question he has been pursuing, unaware of the traps set by Alaz. Which Soysalan made İlker kidnap him when he was a child? His mother? His father? Or his grandfather?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As Yaman is about to decipher Ilker at the dinner held at Rüya's house, the news comes that Cesur was taken from the house by dark men. Yaman learns that what happened to Cesur was because of Alaz, and raids Alaz at the farmhouse party he organized. However, he will completely lose Rüya's trust as a result of what happened at the farmhouse. Yaman is now a real savage in Rüya's eyes. Meanwhile, Alaz wants to take advantage of the tension between Rüya and Yaman, so he decides to open up his feelings to Rüya with a big surprise. While Yaman rushes to save Cesur's life, Ilker is out of control. He now threatens his sister Sebnem that he will turn them in if he is caught. Despite all Sebnem's efforts, Ilker escapes. When Yaman saves Cesur from the trouble he is in, it is too late. Ilker is nowhere to be found. However, his collaborator takes him to the fugitive Ilker by his own hand. Now he knows who kidnapped him from his family. Now, it is time for a confrontation.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Yaman is now sure that Ilker's collaborator is his father. However, it will not be easy to convince Neslihan that it was her husband who kidnapped her son. With the help of Cesur and Asi, Yaman devises a plan to expose his father and succeeds. Now Neslihan has to face the truth, no matter how difficult it is. Because she has found the answer to the question "Why would a father do this to his son?". Realizing that he has reached the end of the road, Serhan escapes. Alaz and Yaman cross paths on their way to find Serhan. However, one of them wants to save his father and the other wants to settle scores. When the two brothers find Serhan in his hiding place, the truth they encounter will change all the balances in the Soysalan family again.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Convinced that Yaman was kidnapped by his uncle Caner Soysalan, the Soysalans are trying to get back on their feet. Neslihan now asks her children to be siblings again. The day Alaz and Çağla open their wounds by accusing Neslihan of being a mother she could not do in the past, Yaman realizes that he is not the only missing child in this family. He promises his mother to be a big brother to Ali's siblings. On the way he sets out to save Çağla from Rüzgar, he will experience in the most painful way that Alaz will never be his brother. Serhan, who is now a hero for his entire family, melts the ice between him and Neslihan, and his love for his wife flares up again. This situation makes Şebnem make a big move to break this relationship. As Güven enters the hospital with his son Yaman, the first of the secret doors of the past, which were thought to be closed, opens...

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: While Serhan and Neslihan are trying to get over the shock of being confronted by doctor Güven, they are drawn into a new vortex when Rüzgar, who is in a terminal condition, is brought to the hospital. Alaz confesses his crime to his father. As Çağla's anger against her brother Yaman grows, the police arrest Yaman for beating Rüzgar. While Serhan tries to protect his own son Alaz, Güven also helps his own son Yaman. Cesur shares with Yaman the possibility that the real culprit is Alaz, and a new door of hope opens for Asi. While Eşref decides to perform an autopsy to prove his son Caner's innocence, doctor Güven stands before him, even after many years, and asks him to account for the past. When Yaman reaches the evidences of the crime that will burn Alaz, Rüzgar has survived the critical period and is preparing to testify. However, Alaz has a big surprise for both his family and Yaman. The boat, which is speeding towards the open, has another surprise passenger...

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: As Alaz drives away with the boat he is fleeing, Rüzgar's statement to the police shocks Serhan. While Asi and Cesur blame Yaman for the statement he gave to the police, Alaz has a new confession to his father Serhan. Yaman sits at the same table with Güven and shares his troubles. When Çağla learns that it was not only Yaman but also Alaz who put Rüzgar into a coma, she draws both of her brothers into a terrible trap in order to teach them a lesson. While Doctor Güven decides on the surgery necessary for Umut to walk, Serhan pursues a plan that the devil would never think of. According to the plan, Umut will die, while Ece will recover and return home. While Serhan and Şebnem are shaken by the information that Eşref wants an autopsy, Serhan gives Şebnem the lesson of her life. While Yaman and Rüya renew their love, Asi and Alaz are left paralyzed by the sealed love. While Alaz makes a move that shocks Asi, Serhan puts the biggest obstacle in front of Yaman's love for Rüya.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Yaman is shattered with the information he received from his father. Alaz also loves Rüya. Yaman has to give up his love for Rüya if he wants this enmity to end. While Rüya holds Yaman's hands unaware of what is going on, Alaz pursues Asi with his love pain. The night of the two young people ends when Yaman confronts them. Çağla tells Rüzgar that she is pregnant. This is a unique opportunity for Rüzgar. He will marry Çağla and take revenge on the Soysalan family.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Yaman and Alaz rush Çağla to the hospital at the last minute. Neslihan and Serhan are shaken with pain when they see their daughter in that state. At the last moment, Güven foils Serhan's plan and manages to save Umut. Now, his new task is to support the family that has been torn apart by Çağla's pain. While Eşref raids Rüzgar's family's house, Serhan informs the police. Everyone is looking for Rüzgar. While Rüya buries the pain of separation and tries to support Yaman, Asi also supports Alaz. Yaman and Alaz, who inform their friends to find Rüzgar, take action from different sides. Neslihan took her daughter out of the hospital and took her to the farmhouse. While Çağla is trying to recover with the attention of her family, Cesur's mind is also on Çağla. Rüya, who thinks that the family is in the farmhouse, goes to see Çağla. But she gets an unexpected surprise. Yaman and Alaz find a clue about Rüzgar... But this clue leads to a dark story that the two brothers will have to solve.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After finding blood in the trunk, Alaz and Yaman go to the house in the countryside to find Rüzgar and find Rüya covered in blood.  Alaz and Yaman are determined to get Rüya out of this situation without implicating her, and they are willing to do anything to do so, and they do just that. His father Adil, who knows that Rüzgar is in that house, goes to find his son and encounters an unexpected scene. Worried about his son, Adil reports to the police. While the Soysalan family members are taken into police custody, Yaman comes to Rüya, who is brought home by Alaz, unaware of this. Yaman takes Rüya and takes them to the bottom of hell, where no one can find them. When Alaz goes to the hospital, he comes across a clue and pursues this mystery. Determined to solve the mystery and save Rüya, Alaz will encounter something he never expected at the end of the road. As Asi tells Alaz, he will be crushed under the mystery he has been digging, but who will be the one who can shoulder it all?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Güven is determined to save Yaman, who is in Adil's hands, at the cost of his life, and Adil is determined to avenge his son Rüzgar no matter what... Eşref, who will give the answer to stop Adil, arrives and faces a confrontation with the past. While everyone was surprised and saddened by Serhan's surrender, Serhan, who was determined to leave Güven out of the game, planted the seeds of a new plan before he even stepped into prison. He will choose Yaman Ali as his outside hand for this plan. Alaz, on the other hand, will be very uncomfortable with this task being assigned to Yaman, and another rivalry will emerge that will inflame the friction between them. Rüya will learn that she is the reason for the rivalry between Yaman and Alaz after all these events, and Rüya, who has also argued with her mother Şebnem about her father, will set out on a new path in the following process. The person and the truths she encounters on this path will affect not only her but also Serhan and Şebnem.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Güven decides not to go after talking with Şebnem. This decision will not only bring great surprise to the Soysalans, but will also cause Serhan to sow the seeds of a new plan. The release of Rüya's father, Metin, from prison will be another cause of tension for Serhan. How will Serhan, who is squeezed from both sides, get out of this situation? After the truth about her father, Rüya takes shelter in Asi. Asi understands her better after the evening she spent with Rüya. When she believes that Yaman is the only cure for Rüya, she will make a move that will make Alaz very angry. While Cesur is trying to make the princess Çağla, who is still in the recovery process, smile, Serhan sees him. Cesur, who sees Serhan's true face, Yaman, who sees his father as a good family man; the ropes are stretched between them. Still, they come together in Umut's dream football match. As Umut starts to recover and fulfills his dreams one by one after the surgery, fate will have different plans for Umut.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Although the death of Umut, who fell victim to Serhan's game, will cause a great mourning effect in Asi, Cesur, Yaman Ali, Umut will leave the world by giving hope to many people, especially Ece. Yaman Ali, Asi and Cesur disperse in different directions under this feeling of mourning. While Asi goes to the ghetto, her accomplice Alaz, who will not leave her alone, will be with her. Cesur, on the other hand, mourns Umut's death and will find himself in the dirt. While all this is going on, Yaman Ali falls apart, but Rüya will come to his aid as his compass. With the information he receives from Metin, Yaman will be involved in the plan of Güven, who is after Umut's murderer. While Serhan is dealing with the problems caused by the results of his game; It will intersect with the duo Güven and Yaman. Determined to exclude Güven from the game, Serhan is trying to get rid of the fact that Güven is Yaman Ali's father. How will this fact be revealed by someone he never guessed affect his game?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: When Yaman returns home with his family, the Soysalans, after his brother Umut's funeral, Alaz meets them with a fact that will surprise everyone. This fact is that Yaman Ali's father is doctor Güven Aydın. Yaman Ali is not the only one shaken; at the same time, the building blocks of the Soysalan family are shaken, one by one. While Yaman's father, Güven Aydın, tells the truth to everyone, this truth puts Neslihan in the position of a lying mother who has kept this secret for years. Feeling like he doesn't belong anywhere, Yaman Ali returns to his siblings Asi and Cesur. New Year's Eve arrives; Ece returns home with the bitterness of being healed with Umut's heart, and while the Soysalans normalize a little, Yaman continues to live in his old neighborhood with his siblings Cesur and Asi. We see an Alaz who is swollen from all that has happened and cannot digest it. But how far can Alaz go in this state? Who will pay the penalty for his inability to digest these facts?

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Unable to digest what happened, Alaz takes out his anger on Yaman and Rüya, with the effect of the pill he used. This anger causes a car accident. The first day of the year starts with concern for the Soysalans because there is no news about their sons Yaman and Alaz, while Metin and Şebnem also notice the absence of Rüya. When Neslihan and Güven reach Yaman, they learn about the accident. While Yaman saves Rüya's life with the guidance of Neslihan and Güven, he is, as always, unaware of the impact of the accident on himself. When Serhan reaches Alaz, he finds himself overwhelmed by guilt. Only Alaz, Serhan and the person neither of them guessed, Yaman, have the knowledge that the person who caused Yaman Ali and Rüya's accident was Alaz. Yaman, who learns that Serhan is involved in this after waking up, makes a plan to pressure Serhan and Alaz from all sides. While the plan is to show Serhan's true face to the Soysalans, who will support Yaman Ali? How effective will this plan be?

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Yaman's orchestrated game renders all of Serhan's victim scenarios meaningless. Now, Serhan must calculate his aggressive final moves to keep Neslihan in his grasp. In front of Neslihan, there are two paths. Either succumb to the blackmail presented by Serhan as the final card, or escape from the corner she's pushed into with Yaman's help, take control, and fight not to lose her children to Serhan. Alaz feels the most regret towards Asi for what has happened. Their love, fueled by hatred, grows even more, unnoticed by them. As Alaz, stabbed by Asi, struggles for life in Güven's hands, Serhan's anger, cornered from all sides, focuses solely on Yaman and his father. His resentment fuels the enmity between Alaz and Yaman.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: While Eşref's murder falls like lightning on the house of Soysalans, Yaman Ali is sure that Serhan is the one who did this. However, the blame was placed on his father, Güven, instead of Serhan. Yaman frantically pursues the truth to save his father. Serhan returns to the Soysalans household, taking advantage of Neslihan's paternal pain emptiness that takes him away from home, his children and himself. The only way he can stay in that house is a formula he has used in the past. Realizing this, Yaman's reaction will be at a level that Serhan can't predict. While Alaz continues to support his father, Çağla enters a dark path. Cesur and Asi find Çağla in a scattered state and put themselves in danger to help her. But they find Alaz. The fact that Asi and Alaz are on different sides in this incident makes their relationship even more tense. Yaman sets out on this journey with his compass, Rüya, and reaches key secrets. However, the reality of facts can profoundly shake everyone's lives.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Yaman Ali is determinedly pursuing proof that Serhan is responsible for his grandfather's death. What they learn from the driver shows that Serhan's accomplice is Şebnem. But will Yaman Ali be able to risk dragging their relationship into a dead end by becoming suspicious of Rüya's mother, with whom he started this journey? After Yaman Ali and his neighborhood friends pick up his mother from the Soysalanlar household, another curtain of mystery opens. Throughout her marriage, Neslihan learned that Serhan was the real responsible for every mistake she blamed herself for. All his children, including Alaz and Çağla, take care of Neslihan, but Serhan is now left alone and has to pay for his sins. Neslihan wants to take shelter in Güven in this difficult time. But as the former lovers open their notebooks about the past, a name they come across will hit them with the realities of life like a slap in the face.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Yaman is sure that Serhan and Şebnem are the ones who killed Eşref and corners them. This information, which is heard by everyone at the memorial ceremony, falls like a bomb on the Soysalan agenda. Rüya is the most affected by this. Yaman's suspicion of her mother opens an irreversible path for both of them. For Neslihan, it is extremely devastating that the two people she has kept closest to her for years are taken to the Police Department as suspects in her father's murder. As she searches for a safe harbor, Güven's wife Özge appears in front of her, and the truth painfully hits her in the face. Rüya, shaken by her mother's arrest as a murder suspect, learns even more painful truths from her father Metin. Şebnem and Serhan try to pin all the blame on Metin. In order to protect what's left of her family, Rüya embarks on a struggle even against Yaman. As she moves forward, not knowing that the path she is on is a thin rope, Yaman is determined not to give up on her at any cost.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Rüya sets fire to the house where she lives with all the memories of her father, Metin. Yaman Ali disregards his own life to ensure that she clings to life. However, Rüya is now against him and her mother, Şebnem. The person who helps Rüya is someone no one expected. The Wild inside Yaman Ali is about to resurface as Rüya moves further and further away from him. Cleared of murder, Serhan is determined to win his children back. But the children are not ready to forgive him. First of all, Alaz. All the arrangements made by Eşref before his death left Serhan penniless. As February 14 approaches, Alaz tries to have a say in Asi's life. Asi will take the stage at Tolga's barroom and draw a brand new path for herself. But Alaz's heart is not happy with this. What happens on Valentine's Day shows that Özge and Güven are on the verge of a decision. Güven is faced with the question he fears most. Will he have to choose between the two women he loves, Özge and Neslihan?

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Yaman Ali, who learned that his father Güven had another son, had a bad start with Deniz, who had just arrived from abroad. The mistakes he makes one after another lead Yaman to seek peace on the streets again. At such a time, the announcement of his grandfather Eşref Ali Soysalan's will inevitably draws Yaman back to the world he escaped from. Serhan took out his claws. The games he plays to get his children to his side push Neslihan into a corner. While an inheritance storm is brewing in the Soysalanlar household, Alaz lets a girl he met at the bistro into the house just to drive Asi crazy. What is important for Asi is to find out whether Alaz really betrayed her or not. While Rüya, who is going through a period prone to emotional abuse, thinks that Deniz is trying to help her, she is not aware that she is actually being manipulated. While Yaman Ali thinks he has found a new brother, he is actually facing his most dangerous enemy.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Yaman realizes that Deniz is a clinical case unlike any he has encountered before, after hearing about the message sent by Rüya to Deniz. Unaware of everything, Rüya is being manipulated by Deniz. Yaman has no choice but to prove to everyone Deniz's manipulative personality. After Serhan regains control of the hospital management, his first move surprises Güven and Neslihan. Özge hears from Serhan what she needs to hear from Güven. This situation makes it easier for Serhan to use Özge against Güven and Neslihan. The conflict between Yaman and Deniz brings Neslihan and Özge back face to face. Deniz realizes that if he wants to defeat Yaman, he needs to pull everyone to his side. The only person he cannot influence is Alaz, who goes crazy when he sees Deniz around Asi. As Cesur progresses step by step in mafia affairs, his brave personality rapidly propels him forward. But an unexpected encounter will bring back the greatest pains Yaman and his friends went through on the streets.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Yaman realizes that the person responsible for the traumas of his, Cesur and Asi's childhood, spent on the streets, is right under his nose. He must face this ghost alone, keep Asi and Cesur away, and not endanger Rüya. But as he gets closer to his goal, he realizes how close the danger actually is to all of them. Serhan's realization of his connection to this man takes things to a whole new level. This new, but actually old enemy, strengthens the bond between Yaman and Alaz. Realizing how the events of the past left their mark on Asi, Alaz clings even closer to his love, which he can no longer reject. But it's not easy to repair the wounds inflicted on Asi's heart, and his own mistakes push Asi into the very heart of danger. It's not easy for Güven and Özge to accept the truths about Özge. However, Neslihan lends a helping hand to Özge in an impossible situation. Two women are tested with both their love and motherhood. And one of them will now have to know how to retreat.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Yaman now has only one goal. Face victory and take your revenge! Whatever it takes. But as he approaches his goal, he meets the person he least expects. Zafer's plan to use Soysalan Hospital as a tool for his dirty criminal network depends entirely on Serhan's attitude. Serhan sees that if he tries to resist, his family and Neslihan will be in danger. Özge starts to use her position as chief physician to keep Neslihan and Güven away from each other. Neslihan, on the other hand, notices that Yaman and Alaz are doing secret things and worries about what kind of problems her sons are facing. After meeting Zafer, Asi and Cesur come face to face with their past, which they tried to forget. For Cesur, what happened is a more difficult trauma to overcome. Alaz takes care of Asi. Yaman tries to protect Rüya by keeping her away from himself. Yaman and Alaz are shoulder to shoulder as brothers for the first time. But will it be possible to stop Yaman from walking to death on the path of revenge?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: As Yaman takes a dangerous turn on the road to revenge against Zafer Demirhan, the lives of his loved ones and his own hang in the balance. Serhan realizes that the only way to escape the imminent danger facing Neslihan, himself, and their children is to do as told. Unaware of the danger, Neslihan becomes irked by the reactions to her presence around Zafer. Meanwhile, tension rises between Özge and Güven, leading to the realization of Özge's fears. With the help of Alaz and Asi, Yaman tracks Zafer's moves using Leyla. They discover that another child's life is in danger. Rüya rebels against the closeness between Leyla and Yaman, not knowing the true reason behind it. Yaman takes action to ensure that another innocent person does not fall victim to Zafer's dirty deeds. For both Alaz and Yaman, it is time to make irreversible choices. And Yaman is ready to both die and kill on this path.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The heavy burden of killing Yaman and not being able to save Asi now falls on Alaz's shoulders. After watching the video sent by Zafer, Serhan rushes to his son Alaz. But Alaz now knows that Serhan is helping Zafer and pushes his father away. He has only one goal: not to lose Asi like Yaman. While everyone is after little Melek, protecting this innocent girl is Yaman's legacy to Rüya. Rüya firmly embraces this legacy. She is about to realize that she has to protect Melek from Serhan the most. Serhan, who has to choose between his conscience and logic, has already made his decision. Neslihan, on the other hand, cannot accept that her son is dead. Together with Güven, she goes after a trail belonging to Yaman. Zafer Demirhan is now everyone's target. Cesur enters an irreversible dead end with the motivation to avenge both his childhood and Yaman. As everyone's true face is revealed, one by one, a secret helping hand from the past reaches out.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Elif approaches Yaman, whom she reunites with after years, and his close circle with the reflex of a policewoman, and she does not trust Rüya in the first place. This shakes the whole friendship balance. New information will show whether Elif is right or wrong. Elif holds such a key in the world that she enters with her police identity, and she will be the salvation of some and the nightmare of others. Neslihan, threatened by Özge to completely break away from Güven, is forced to hug Serhan while falling into the sea. Neslihan must both protect Güven and keep Serhan under control. Yaman helps Tolga, who has to free himself from the dark legacy of his father, Zafer. At the venue, all the young people organize a party for the children. Asi and Alaz are aware of the dimension they have jumped to in their relationship after declaring their love for each other at the brink of death. But during the event, Rüya receives information that turns her whole world upside down.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Neslihan and Güven embrace their twenty-year love after all the obstacles they face. While Serhan is waiting for the moment when the game he set up for them will explode, Güven and Neslihan are caught up in the belief that love will overcome every obstacle. But this love seems to bring Yaman and Alaz, who have just accepted their brotherhood, back to the old days. Alaz's love for Asi, on the other hand, is about to be tested by the class difference between them. Is their love strong enough to overcome this test? The mystery of who kidnapped Yaman when he was a child is now on its way to being solved. Believing that Neslihan has finally found happiness, Feride shares the information she has with the police. After what Melek said, Rüya pressures her mother to tell the truth. But will it be possible for her to share what she has learned with Yaman? Is the truth stronger or do the two have unshakable trust in each other? Yaman and Hayal's love is about to be tested by Melek's fate.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: When it's revealed that Serhan lured Neslihan into the marriage trap, Güven loses control. Just as Yaman is about to reveal Serhan's whole deception because of what Melek will tell him, Güven's uncontrolled outburst gives Serhan a much-needed trump card. Although the price is heavy, Serhan will use this new trump card to the fullest. Rüya is willing to remain silent for a while only for the sake of her brother who will be born. Yaman is now sure that she is hiding something, but he can't figure out what. When Alaz and Çağla share Rüya's secret, things get complicated. Will not only his girlfriend, but also his brothers lie to Yaman? Once again, Alaz rebels against the fate to which his father has led him. The fear that he will harm Asi one day makes Alaz take some steps he doesn't want. Yaman, who is now confused about who to trust, begins to take Elif's warnings seriously. However, Elif's efforts to expose all the lies told to Yaman are about to result in someone being seriously hurt.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Elif leaves a clue to Yaman with her last remaining strength. Yaman follows this clue to find out who hit her and ran away. There is no one left to trust except Asi and Cesur. Young people follow Rüya, Alaz and Çağla separately. Alaz is hurt when Asi approaches him to gather information. Neslihan also tries to intervene in the stormy relationship of the two young people. Under all this pressure, will Alaz be able to act like Serhan's son and continue lying to Yaman? Yaman decides to trust the feeling of brotherhood that has strengthened between him and Alaz. Çağla is still under the influence of her father and tends to protect him. This brings the two face to face with Rüya. The only reason why Rüya remains silent is the baby in Şebnem's womb. But if Şebnem's other crimes are revealed, will it be possible to silence Rüya? Yaman, on the other hand, just when he begins to believe that he can attract Alaz to his side, a disaster shows them all that the price they will pay is very heavy.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Despite all efforts, Rüya can't be found. The world stops for Yaman. Neslihan and Güven's only goal is to try to keep their son alive. Çağla lies about what happened with Rüya. She tries to hide the audio recording of Şebnem, which proves all of Serhan's crimes. Alaz is forced to share his sister's lie. The only person who can prevent Alaz from destroying himself is Asi. But Asi is determined to find out what the twins are hiding. As Rüya's fate becomes clear, Şebnem becomes the focus of Yaman's anger. Yaman's only goal is to catch Şebnem, who sacrificed her daughter for her own sins. Serhan realized his dream and returned home with his family. Now he must find and eliminate Şebnem without spoiling his plans. However, Şebnem is determined not to get burned without dragging Serhan with her, and she hatches a plan. And the outcome of Serhan and Şebnem's clash has the power to affect everyone's fate.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Yaman has only one goal: to save Rüya! Rüya is locked up among people who can't even explain who she really is and who don't believe in her. And the danger is growing. For Serhan, who thinks he has Şebnem under control, the only risk left to eliminate is Rüya. Will Yaman find Rüya in time? Or is the young girl about to fall into Serhan's hands like her mother? Serhan's capture depends on all his children seeing his true face and being with Yaman. Çağla, on the other hand, is cornered by Yakup. Asi and Alaz intervene in the situation. Alaz's move to protect his sister is such that it will push the limits of love. To attract his brothers to his side, Yaman creates an all-or-nothing game. But as the walls he built with secrets collapse, there is nothing left that Serhan won't dare to do anymore.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Everyone has now seen Serhan's true face. Serhan, who has no choice but to escape, dares to blackmail her family by holding Neslihan hostage. Determined not to sacrifice his brothers to Serhan, Yaman tries to hide their mother's kidnapping from the children. But it will not be easy to keep Alaz away from this terrible truth. The biggest confrontation with Serhan is now inevitable. Yaman will do whatever it takes to save his mother. But the only power that can get Serhan out of his hole is his children. Çağla turns herself into a bait with the remorse she carries. Ece, on the other hand, reaches some truths before anyone else. Serhan is about to be tested with the thing he trusts most: his children. Serhan's pressures starts Şebnem's early labor pains. On the one hand, Neslihan has to save both the baby and the mother. On the one hand, Yaman is determined to reach them in time and not let Serhan slip away. However, at the end of this race there are very painful losses for everyone.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: After the loss of Ece, no one reacts as expected, except for Yaman… Yaman doesn’t want the innocent life left behind by Şebnem to grow up without a family like himself. However, the magnitude of the tragedy is so immense that everyone is being pulled in different directions. Once again, the price of the parents’ sins will be paid by an innocent child. Serhan’s continued fugitive status forces Neslihan to be excessively protective of her other children even before she can properly mourn. Asi, on the other hand, is involved in developments that could unlock brighter futures with Alaz. However, first, Alaz must overcome the darkness left in his mind by Serhan. When Serhan learns he has another son, he moves to kidnap him as well. Yaman and Neslihan, noticing the snake lurking insidiously close, fall victim to its venom. In order for their loved ones to move towards a happier future, they must confront this demon one last time, even if it means tormenting their lives.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Yaman has taken care of all his siblings in Neslihan’s absence. He has shelved all his resentments, loneliness, and pain. His only wish once reunited with his mother, is to entrust his siblings to her and embark on his own journey. He has more than fulfilled his duties as a brother and a son, but then he experiences the greatest tragedy of his life. Neslihan, on the other hand, has reunited with her children and Güven, but they are hiding something from her. She is still unaware of Serhan’s new schemes. While trying to uncover the truth, she also wants to make up for the lost time as quickly as possible. Her only dream is to marry Güven and find happiness. On the other side, separation, heartbreak, and, most importantly, regrets have torn Alaz and Asi apart. Alaz is ready to do anything to reunite with Asi, but first, he must find her. Asi has already built her own prison and believes no one can save her.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Yaman is shocked and devastated by Rüya's death. His pain is immense, but his anger is on all of them. He will find the killer or killers. While the police investigate the murder, Yaman is actually one step ahead of them. Rüya will show him that he is on the right path. Alaz and Asi finally meet. Will two years of longing and anger be a reunion or a new goodbye? While Neslihan and Güven are afraid of what Yaman will do, they are also dealing with the other children's problems. In the midst of all this, what Yaman learns about the murder will be a shock for him, too.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Rüya's file is closed, but for Yaman everything is just beginning. He is now the founder of a big game. All he needs is a new ally. He achieves this in a rational way. He holds the cards in his hand and he is the one dealing them. On the Alaz and Asi front, all secrets are revealed, but nothing is as it seems. The real big secret will turn both of their lives upside down.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Yaman's collaboration with Serhan is progressing rapidly. Yaman is driving Hande and Iskender crazy with his new plans. Everything is fine for now, but he is unaware of Alaz and Asi's situation. The captivity of Alaz and Adem will end with death. Even though Asi struggles to save them, Alaz will not stop without saving Asi and his daughter. She rejects the chance given to her to escape and to have her life spared, and the consequences are severe. Asi is now in danger. The end has come for Alaz and Asi. Neslihan is after Çagla. She knows that there is something wrong with her daughter and she is not wrong, but she witnesses an event that would never have crossed her mind. She goes crazy when she sees what she sees. Yaman is moving forward with his plans and is also trying to keep his family together.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: After Yaman is shot by Derin, events develop much faster. After Hande and Iskender, Yaman knows that Derin also is up to something. In fact, he even understands that Derin is playing a game with him. Yaman has to act faster than anyone else. But what happened to his family stops Yaman on his way to his goal. His father getting shot, learning that Asi and Alaz has a child. Now is the time to be with his family. Alaz is crushed under the lie he told. There is no way he can pull himself together, and the more he lies, the more he sinks. In the end, he makes the biggest mistake possible. An unforgivable mistake. When Yaman and Serhan work together, things start to go well. They think they will eventually reveal everything. They are both unaware that they are actually being played in the plan where they are the playmakers.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Yaman actually ruined Hande's game at the last minute with Derin's help, but now he knows that his time is running out. He has to quickly find clues that will incriminate Hande, but what he finds shocks him as well. Meanwhile, Alaz is not yet aware that he has actually done the greatest evil. His only concern is to make the woman he loves happy and he acts without thinking ahead. But the process does not progress as hoped. He is just at the beginning of his test and everything will become more and more difficult. The issue of what Asi's family and the real villains who guide them are capable of is as frightening to Neslihan as it is to Yaman's concern. Despite Alaz and Asi's stubbornness, Yaman has to protect his siblings from these people. But the crowd and the recklessness in front of him scares even Yaman. He is no longer worried for his own life, but for the lives of Asi and Alaz.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: The house raid of Asi's family and the neighborhood is stopped by Yaman and the whole family does what is necessary. While Neslihan tries to keep the whole family safe, Yaman is also pursuing his own issue. He detained Derin after İskender's trick, but his move to blame the murder on Derin brings about the end of İskender. Alexander, on the other hand, has dug his own hole and Hande will get her share. While they are both trying to get away with murder, Yaman is with Güven. These few days are actually like Asi and Alaz's pre-wedding rehearsal. In fact, it is their last peaceful day, unaware that they will experience the beauty of being a family for the first and last time. Could Alaz's lie be the end of their tale? Secrets that have come to an end, villains, endings, new beginnings. While the rebel Alaz front is heading towards the bitter truth within itself, Yaman is also acting with his father on his own path of revenge. These endings will come with a price.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Yaman has been dragged into a big trap and Güven is ready to do anything to save his son. Yaman is aware that his father is in trouble, but he can't do anything. Asi also learned that their baby had died. She blames Alaz. No matter how much Alaz tries to explain himself, Asi is not yet in a position to understand this. While Alaz tries to evade everyone's reactions, he never tries to justify himself. His only concern is Asi and her sadness. Neslihan also gets her share of the predicament that Güven finds herself in. Yaman, on the other hand, sees himself as responsible for everything. While his father keeps him away from the terrible truth he is hiding, the only thing Yaman can do is to make his family happy, even if only a little. He finds a way to bring everyone together. A great happiness that he didn't know would be short...

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: The Neslihans finally regained their home. But this happiness will not last long. The trouble that Güven got into is now seeping into the whole family. The audacity of the woman named Derya also gets on Neslihan's nerves. After his recent experiences, Asi has a painful confrontation with her father. Alaz is also feeling the pain of everyone coming at him and blaming him, but his biggest pain was losing Asi. Even though Asi left him and said it was over, Alaz has no intention of giving up on Asi. But when Alaz hears what happened to Asi and the posters hung in the neighborhood, he cannot remain indifferent about this. He will punish the evil done to Asi. Yaman, on the other hand, is aware that his father is in a dead end. Guven is already paying the price for his under-the-radar surgery. Then there is only one solution left. Whoever those people are will figure it out themselves. But this time, he puts not only himself and his father into danger, but also his mother.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: With Neslihan getting into trouble, both Güven and Yaman are in a dead end. The events will bring about violent arguments within the family. Güven will make one last move to save Neslihan. Even at the cost of his life. No matter how angry Neslihan is, when she finally finds out why Güven did all this, her pain will increase even more. Yaman, on the other hand, has his share of his parents' arguments, but this will not stop him. He put them both in this situation and he thinks he's the only one who can get them out. When Asi and Alaz come together after the poster incident, they have a calm discussion without a fight for the first time, but they actually take out their grief on their daughter's grave. They are both in a lot of pain and they face it.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Yaman stealing the safe throws everything into chaos. Convinced that he is responsible for İskender’s death, Yaman is prepared to sacrifice himself. However, before doing so, he must find İskender’s grave, a task that proves to be anything but easy. With no one else to turn to, he relies on Güven for information. Meanwhile, Güven, who believes his confession will bring everything to an end, realizes that the entire family is now in danger. He urges Neslihan to stay strong, though he himself feels trapped. Determined to protect Yaman, Güven decides to retrieve the safe and turn himself in. Güven isn’t the only one willing to protect Yaman. Alaz also takes action but finds Asi and Derin standing in his way. Despite the tension, Asi is determined to uncover Alaz’s true intentions. Once she learns the truth, she refuses to leave his side. The footage inside the safe holds the power to ruin Hande as well, making it crucial for them to find it.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: The conditions of Yaman and Alaz are critical. Güven and Neslihan have to perform their surgeries, but Neslihan is reluctant. She is forced to do it and consequently makes a serious mistake. The person in the most critical condition is Alaz. He is hovering between life and death… While everyone is striving for Alaz to survive, Asi is living with regret about everything she couldn't tell him. She knows she won't be able to live if she loses Alaz. While Neslihan is struggling to keep her son alive, she also confronts her own painful truth. The struggle for Alaz's survival, the hours spent with those taking the blame for each other's crimes, and regrets. The test begins for a mother, a father, siblings, and lovers…

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: It is revealed that Hande is responsible for everything, but this revelation brings its own set of problems. Everyone is already implicated in the crime and on the police’s radar. The police are set to take Asi and Alaz in, but even though Alaz insists that Asi is innocent, it’s futile. Asi will never allow this to happen. Both of them will face punishment, but the sentence they receive feels like a reward to them. Yaman, on the other hand, is determined to find out why Serhan didn’t hand over the recordings to the police. When he learns the truth, he decides to help Serhan. Eventually, Hande is caught, but she never reveals Can’s whereabouts. Serhan has no one to help him except Yaman. As the two embark on a dangerous mission, Neslihan notices the situation. To prevent Yaman from getting into trouble again, she is forced to act alongside Selçuk.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Neslihan is confused, and her illness is progressively worsening. Although Serhan tries to hide the situation from the whole family, Güven is particularly uneasy about it. Neslihan also tries to convince everyone that everything is normal, but she is actually preparing herself for the inevitable painful end. Therefore, her intention is to spend her remaining time happily with her entire family. However, Güven pressures Neslihan, insisting that she undergo a medical check-up. Yaman will be the one to take care of his mother during this entire process, and Neslihan feels cornered. She wants to keep her illness a secret from her family, but Yaman discovers the truth. He learns the reality... Yet, he will keep the promise he made to his mother. First, they will celebrate Asi and Alaz's happy day, and then they will reveal the situation to everyone, but they are too late.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Even though Neslihan's illness seems hopeless, Güven has no intention of giving up on the woman he loves. However, being banned from practicing medicine and under house arrest are obstacles preventing him from performing the surgery. Despite the prohibitions, he will perform the surgery thanks to Yaman. Despite all the negativity and obstacles, the surgery takes place, but due to complications after the surgery, Neslihan faces the risk of multiple organ failure. Her heart, in particular, cannot withstand this major surgery. At this point, it becomes clear that the only compatible donor is Yaman. Yaman is ready to sacrifice his own life for his mother to live. For Neslihan to survive, one person must die.
